lines.text: Don't move! Your face is a moment!
There's you. The kite.
That's nobody. That's a gap.
(Breathe! Your voice is a moment!)
He's looking at her. She's looking at the Senate.
Typical.
I had to include everyone. It's journalism.
Don't move, my arrival is a moment. What did I miss?
I brought every tape we own. Don't be nice to me.
I shared this clip before I checked it.
So this time, you check. Here is how.
Live in five, four…
We saw it first. Dates down the side.
I checked every line. Twice. I check now.
Checked. Twice. TOP OF TWO COURSES. Four years!
Don't smudge it. Your faces are a moment.
Don't.
Don't move! Your face is a moment!
Breaking news: you're here. Sources confirm. Sources is me.
Ahn ahn! [Oh my!] Look at you. Walking. Live.
Hey! We saw you first. Lily saw you second. She's slow.
And that's all from the field! Back to you, studio. Bye!
Bye! Don't do anything interesting without me.
Thank you! Exclusive thank-you. Nobody else is getting this one.
Sorry! I posted it already. I'll post a sorry. Twice.
Your outfit is giving front page. Turn left. Other left.
You look like a story. A good one. With a happy ending.
You and a certain someone at the Spot. We saw it first. Columns, darling.
Here we see the fresher in the wild. Habitat: the wrong theatre.
I'm following you. For content. And friendship. Mostly content.
We're live in five. Four. You're not here. Three.
Breaking: you're lost. Theatre Gabas is that way. We've all done it.
Yes! Quote me!
No comment. That's a no. With lip gloss.
Maybe. Developing story.
Wait, wait. Rewind. Say it slower. For the tape.
Who? There was nobody there fa. I'd have filmed him.
Exactly! That's my headline!
I can't run that. Lily said no. Lily is legal.
Why did the camera break up? Too many takes. Ha! Lily, laugh.
What happened? Tell me everything. Leave out nothing. Add nothing. I'm learning.
WE WON! Don't move! This is a moment!
We lost. Don't film me. …Film me a little.
Ow! Assault on the press! I'm fine. I'm reporting it to Lily.
I'm down! Get my good side! Both sides!
NEPA has entered the chat. My battery is at four percent. Pray for the story.
Light! Charge everything! The phone! The ring light! My soul!
Lily said it would rain. She's never wrong. It's very annoying.
This heat. My lip gloss has melted into a new shade. 'Ring Road Sunset.'
Suya at the Spot. Live tasting. Hmm. Ten. Lily says nine.
Data finished. A journalist without data is just a girl shouting.
For me? Exclusive! I'll post it. With credit!
Oh. Lovely. I'll… archive it.
A new lip gloss! In my shade! Don't move, I'm reapplying in shock!
And here comes the Faculty of Law, late, again, live.
Lily, look. No, don't look. Okay, look now. Too late.
Night shift at the station. Every sound is a scoop.
You matriculated as a kite. That photo still gets likes.
The class photo. Back row. A gap. I printed it twice.
Fresher! Smile! You're going on the noticeboard!
He's looking at her. She's looking at the Senate. Typical.
Matric photo is up! Everybody looks like a hostage. Beautifully.
That first night on Ring Road FM. I whispered 'breathe'. I forgot to.
Six statues, six love stories. One of them is just staring at a pond.
You and the goat at the court. We saw it first.
You looked so brave in the queue. Hungry, but brave.
Lily, is the statue looking at the hospital? …No. Never mind. Night.
Noticeboard exclusive! I need a quote! Say anything! Not that!
Mall opens. Price of suya doubles. My story. Front page.
Mubarak's opening. Free drinks. Not free. Lyzzy reports.
I included everyone in the test week story. It's journalism.
The radio riddle. Nobody named. Everybody knew. Chills.
Love in the time of NEPA. Who held hands in the blackout? Columns, darling.
Come, the hearing! I have a front-row seat! I made it myself!
Valentine's at the Love Garden. Twelve couples. Two are new. One is a mistake.
Don't move, my arrival is a moment. What did I miss?
Strike. Lily's here. I'm home. We video call. She shows me plants.
Campus TV off air. I'm broadcasting to the mirror. Ratings are great.
Called off! Buses at the gate! Best live coverage of my life!
You stayed through the strike? Hero. Or no bus fare. I'll write both.
Strike month four. I've interviewed my own parents. Twice.
You kept Lily company. She said so. With words. Three of them.
Hello. Before I say anything: have I checked it? Yes. Twice. Hi.
I checked every line. Twice. I check now.
Source. Second source. Then post. Then lip gloss. That's the order.
Lucky posted. I shared. I didn't check. I still think about it.
I shared that clip before I checked. Don't be nice to me.
An Echo repeats. It never invents. We proved it. Live.
The wall chart. Dates down the side. Lily laminated it. I told her not to.
You forgave me fast. Faster than I forgave me.
Lucky says 'link in bio'. Link to what, Lucky? Your conscience?
Live in five, four… election coverage. Checked. Twice.
Final year! Every face is a moment! I'm running out of storage!
Convocation footage. I'm filming everybody. Even the guard Dad argues with.
Five years of tapes. Lily's labelling them. In order. Finally.
Bature's results. I checked them three times. Still true. Still shocking.
Dinner night. Don't smudge it. Your faces are a moment.
You're my favourite story. Don't tell Lily. Lily knows.
Defence day. Your tie is a moment. Not a good one.
After convocation… Don't. I'll cry on the footage.
Freshers' Week! New faces! New moments! Everybody, don't move!
Exam week. No gossip. I'm lying. There's gossip.
Results are up! Don't crowd the board! I'm filming the board!
Allowance! New lip gloss! Breaking news!
Market day. KB's prices went up when he saw my camera. Story.
Cup final, live! Jega's left boot is ON. I repeat, the left boot is on!
Gowns, caps, mothers crying. My finest broadcast. Don't move!
Iftar on the mosque grounds. Three hundred people, one sunset. Beautiful shot.
Christmas break. Lily and I fight over the window seat. Live. Every year.
Valentine's. I'm single. Fact-checked. Twice.
Harmattan haze. Every shot looks like a flashback. I love it. My skin doesn't.
